deploy-bot: Scheduled catalog enable job created for model `harbor-13b:quantv3`
- change window: 2026-03-24T01:00Z -> 2026-03-24T03:00Z
- rollout plan: 1% (10m) -> 10% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (30m)
- initial region: us-west-2; EU followup delayed by 2h
- fallback ordering: harbor-13b:quantv2 -> harbor-13b:fp16 -> harbor-7b:stable
- pin policy: do-not-pin-on-canary; auto-pin after successful 100%
- rollback trigger: >=2% error rate OR 30% p95 latency regression OR failed quality evals

emma: tagging ops for watch. I will be on-call for the first two stages.

sanjay: quick question — can we queue variance-limited traffic to avoid hot shards?

maya: yes, enabling per-pool queueing. config snippet:```yaml
batching: enabled
queue_limit: 200
priority_policy: per-customer
```

jonah: pls add a small grace for cache warmup (5m) before moving from 10% -> 50%

emma: added warmup window 5m between stage 2 and 3. updated rollout plan.

oliver: can we reorder fallbacks so quantv2 is strongly preferred over fp16 when present? I want lower regressions.

emma: done — fallback ordering now: quantv2 (priority 10) -> fp16 (priority 20) -> 7b (priority 50).

sanjay: also adding a soft-degrade rule: if latency spikes transiently, reduce target to previous stage for 10m before rollback.

maya: alarms set in grafana: `harbor-13b_quantv3_error_rate`, `harbor-13b_quantv3_p95_latency`. alert policy: paging if sustained for 3m.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: model checksum OK, quant artifacts verified, container build 4412 passed smoke tests.

jonah: quick note — we'll not auto-pin on canary to allow easy rollback, only pin after 100% success and one successful post-deploy eval.

emma: agreed. also creating release note: "Enable harbor-13b:quantv3 (quantized v3) — improved throughput, monitored fallback ladder." will post to product channel after live.

oliver: I'll watch oom and kv-cache hit rate dashboards. ping if cache miss > 10% during first stage.

maya: can someone run the synthetic prompt set against quantv3 preflight once more? small differences flagged last run.

jonah: running synthetic now: 1200 samples -> diffs within tolerance 0.7% on top-k scoring. posting results in 2m.

deploy-bot: Job queued. Will execute on 2026-03-24T01:00:00Z. Use `redwoodctl catalog status --job 4412` to follow.

emma: thumbs up from me. tagging @support for incident escalation path. :thumbsup:

sanjay: leaving this open for any last-minute objections for 30m.

oliver: no objections from infra. ready to assist rollback if needed.

maya: ready.

jonah: all good from release.

deploy-bot: Notification scheduled: 2026-03-23T23:30:00Z release reminder to #product and #support.
